newsitem.title: TURKEY: Grenade thrown at Greek Orthodox centre in Turkey.
newsitem.headline: Grenade thrown at Greek Orthodox centre in Turkey.

text.p: Turkish Islamist urban guerrillas threw a grenade on Monday at the Greek Orthodox Patriarchate in Istanbul but there were no injuries in the blast, Anatolian news agency said.

The grenade exploded in the garden of the building, the seat of Greek Orthodox Ecumenical Patriarch Bartholomeos I, the agency said. Bartholomeos is the spiritual head of 250 million Orthodox Christians worldwide.
Anatolian said the blast caused minor damage in the garden. An armed Islamist group, Great Eastern Islamic Raiders - Front (IBDA-C) claimed responsibility for the attack, the agency said.
Four suspected members of the group were arrested in late 1994 for allegedly attacking the Patriarchate earlier that year.
